summary: Immune to Frightened; Intimidation proficiency and Expertise. Reference-only: Reaction when a visible Frightened creature within 60 feet starts its turn without Total Cover: Wisdom DC 8 + Charisma modifier + PB or spend its turn fleeing you by its fastest means. Once per Short or Long Rest.
